exposure: gestational age at termination of pregnancy (TOP)
method of TOP (misoprostol, uterine balloon, misoprostol and balloon combination, oxytocin)
outcome: maternal complications (rehospitalization, rest placenta, infection, uterine rupture, blood transfusion, repeated manual vacuum curettage, hysterotomy)
cohort: The study included 231 patients who underwent termination of pregnancy at a single tertiary center between April 2019 and March 2023.
finding: Termination of pregnancy (TOP) during advanced gestation is associated with increased rates of maternal complications, with higher gestational age and previous uterine surgery being primary contributors.
mod_finding: A higher rate of previous cesarean sections was found in the group with complications during termination of pregnancy.
gest_age: The gestational age at TOP ranged from 11 to 30 weeks, with median gestational ages of 18.0 ± 3.3 weeks for women without complications and 19.5 ± 5.1 weeks for those with complications.
